description.value: Small Gods Brewing Co. is a family-owned microbrewery and taproom in Sidney, BC, situated minutes from the Swartz Bay Ferry Terminal and about 25 minutes north of Victoria. The brewery draws deep inspiration from literature, hosting monthly author readings, book swaps, and a book club, making it a notably community-rooted gathering space. Cyclists stopping in will find a rotating lineup of house-brewed ales and lagers alongside a counter-service deli of house-baked sandwiches and snacks, with a dog-friendly patio.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at smallgods.ca is live and confirms an operating brewpub-taproom at 9835 Third St, Sidney, BC, with an active rotating tap list, deli menu, FAQ, and event listings that corroborate the OSM address. The FAQ explicitly states deli food can be 'eaten in or taken away' and 4-packs of beer are available to go; the menu includes a smoked-tofu sandwich as an identifiable vegetarian option. No bike-specific amenities (racks, pump, Wi-Fi, charging) are mentioned anywhere on the site, and the OSM name 'Small Gods Brewpub' differs from the website's consistent branding as 'Small Gods Brewing Co.'
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records the business as 'Small Gods Brewpub' but the website consistently uses 'Small Gods Brewing Co.' — OSM name retained per schema rules.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, open microbrewery and taproom with confirmed food and takeout service; a natural rest stop for touring cyclists on the Saanich Peninsula.

Takeout.detail: Website FAQ states sandwiches and light snacks can be 'eaten in or taken away'; 4-packs of beer are available to go (no growler or crowler fills)

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes 'The Hanoi' — braised smoked tofu with hoisin chili sauce, cucumber, jalapeño, and pickled daikon on a house-baked bun — as a vegetarian sandwich option

wow_evidence: family-owned microbrewery … hosting monthly author readings, book swaps, and a book club … minutes from the Swartz Bay Ferry Terminal
